_about: EV-004 gold cases for citation resolution (REQ-002). Live cases reference real /answer responses in evals/fixtures/exa-live; synthetic cases are labeled.
labelStatus: Assistant-proposed from the citation rule in docs/futari/ARCHITECTURE.md section 'Citations'. Gold once plan kensaku-mvp-v1 is approved.
rule: A marker is '[' s n (s ',' s n)* s ']' where each n is one or more ASCII digits read as a base-10 integer and s is zero or more spaces or tabs (never a newline). Marker n resolves to citations[n-1].url. An n outside 1..citations.length is removed from the rendered text and counted in unresolvedMarkers. A kept marker is rendered as '[' n (',' n)* ']' with no spaces and each n written as its integer value (no leading zeros); a marker with no kept n is removed together with the spaces or tabs before it. Paragraphs are separated by one or more blank lines, a blank line being a line that contains only spaces, tabs or carriage returns; the whole text is one paragraph when there are none, and whitespace-only blocks are not paragraphs. A paragraph with zero resolved markers is flagged uncited. Rendered source links are exactly the resolved citation URLs, de-duplicated in first-use order.
ruleRevision: CR-001 (plan revision 2026-11-21, D-026): optional spaces or tabs inside markers; kept markers render canonically (no spaces, no leading zeros). The revision also writes down three behaviors the original labels already assumed: what a blank line is, that whitespace-only blocks are not paragraphs, and that a marker with no kept n is removed with the spaces before it. None of C01-C06 contains spaced markers or leading zeros, so their labels are unchanged. Spaced-marker cases live in evals/cases/citations-spaced.json.
